name: Azure OpenAI
billing: Requires an Azure subscription, a compatible model deployment and quota. Prices vary by deployed model and region; check the resource’s Azure pricing before calling it.

regions.name: Your deployment region
regions.note: Use the endpoint, deployment name and API version for your actual Azure resource. A general OpenAI model name is not an Azure deployment.

steps: Sign in with an Azure subscription and permissions to create Azure OpenAI resources and model deployments.
Create or select a compatible Azure OpenAI resource. Deploy the model you intend to call and confirm its regional quota.
From that resource, obtain its endpoint and key. Configure your own application with that endpoint, key, deployment name and compatible API version. No Azure resource is created by this site.
